items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So Isham Jones flew up, heard the band and liked it.

ctx.x: Well Johnny Carlson took me out and I got I was going to school. So, Stevens called me and said Isham Jones was coming back in the business and was looking for a band that was already organized. And would I be interested because I told Jack Tiboo on the telephone it was getting pretty rough. So I didn't know whether I'd stay in college, but he said, "Well, you know your family, I think you'd better stay." This -- before this happened. So Isham Jones flew up, heard the band and liked it. So they want said, do you…
